Question 3
?

A=[10−30010000100201] Find the row operations that transform the matrix A above into the identity matrix.

a
R4:=R4+R2 and R1:=R1+(−3)R3
b
R4:=R4+2R2 and R3:=R3+3R1
c
R3:=R3+2R2 and R4:=R4+3R3
d
R2:=R2+2R4 and R1:=R1+(−3)R3
e
R4:=R4+(−2)R2 and R1:=R1+3R3
